description: CAL FIRE Healthy Forests and Wildfire Prevention Outcomes is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by CAL FIRE. Starting in 2019, the Legislature committed about $1 billion over five years to CAL FIRE to advance the state's wildfire prevention and forest health efforts. CAL FIRE wrote a report to the Legislature detailing the outcomes of the projects implemented with this investment. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher CAL FIRE. Its tags are CAL FIRE, California Forest Carbon Plan, Forest and Fire, Grants, cal fire. It offers 2 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
